question: A company uses a corporate identity provider and has 40 AWS accounts. Employees need a single sign-in experience and different permissions in development and production. Which approach minimizes ongoing identity administration?

options.text: Create one IAM role in the management account and assume its permissions automatically authorize employees in all member accounts.
options.explanation: Role pada satu account tidak otomatis memberi account assignments dan permissions berbeda di semua account organisasi.

options.text: Connect the identity provider to IAM Identity Center and assign groups to account-specific permission sets.
options.explanation: Identitas tetap terpusat, sedangkan permission set membedakan akses tiap akun.

options.text: Create an IAM user for every employee in every AWS account and synchronize passwords with a script.
options.explanation: Duplikasi identitas menambah pekerjaan provisioning dan pencabutan akses.

options.text: Create a Cognito user pool and add all AWS account administrators as application users.
options.explanation: User pool tidak menggantikan assignment akses workforce ke akun AWS.

question: Developers already use IAM Identity Center to access AWS accounts. They need command-line access without storing long-term IAM user access keys. Which solution fits this requirement?

options.text: Store one IAM user access key in a shared Secrets Manager secret for all developers.
options.explanation: Secret terenkripsi tetap berisi kredensial permanen bersama.

options.text: Create one IAM user per developer and store its access keys in the local CLI credentials file.
options.explanation: Ini tetap menggunakan long-term IAM user keys, berlawanan dengan kebutuhan temporary sessions.

options.text: Configure a user-pool JWT as the AWS CLI access key without a supported credential exchange.
options.explanation: JWT aplikasi bukan pasangan AWS signing credentials; CLI perlu alur sesi/credential yang didukung.

options.text: Configure AWS CLI profiles for IAM Identity Center and obtain temporary sessions through sign-in.
options.explanation: CLI dapat menggunakan sesi federasi; tidak perlu membuat access key permanen per developer.

question: An organization wants its support engineers to view production resources but not change them. The engineers already belong to a corporate Support group synchronized with IAM Identity Center. Which actions establish the required access? Select TWO.

options.text: Create a permission set containing only the read permissions required for support work.
options.explanation: Permission set menetapkan batas aktivitas yang dibutuhkan.

options.text: Assign the group to the development accounts only and assume the assignment applies to production.
options.explanation: Assignments berlaku pada account yang dipilih; akses development tidak otomatis mencakup production.

options.text: Create the read-only permission set but leave it unassigned to all users and groups.
options.explanation: Mendefinisikan permission set tanpa assignment tidak memberikan akses Support ke account production.

options.text: Attach AdministratorAccess to the Support group in every account.
options.explanation: Hak administrator melebihi kebutuhan read-only.

options.text: Assign the Support group to that permission set in the production accounts.
options.explanation: Assignment menghubungkan grup, izin, dan akun sasaran.

question: EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group upload invoices to a specific S3 prefix. New instances must obtain access automatically without receiving stored access keys. What should a solutions architect configure?

options.text: Bake an IAM user access key into the machine image used by the group.
options.explanation: Kredensial permanen akan tersebar pada setiap image dan instance.

options.text: Attach the S3 upload policy only to the IAM user that launches the Auto Scaling group.
options.explanation: Identitas yang meluncurkan group tidak otomatis menjadi identitas API instance; workload membutuhkan instance profile/role.

options.text: Attach an instance profile with an IAM role allowing uploads only to the invoice prefix.
options.explanation: Instance baru memperoleh identitas workload dengan izin yang dibatasi prefix.

options.text: Add an S3 gateway endpoint and rely on its route table as the only authorization control.
options.explanation: Endpoint menyediakan jalur akses; route table tidak memberikan IAM write permissions kepada instance.

question: An application running in an ECS task on Fargate needs to read a DynamoDB table. The task starts successfully, but its application API calls are denied. Which role should receive the table read permissions?

options.text: The ECS task execution role, because it is used for every application request.
options.explanation: Execution role bukan identitas umum bagi kode aplikasi.

options.text: Grant the table permissions only to the ECS service-linked role that manages service resources.
options.explanation: Service-linked role untuk operasi layanan bukan role credential yang digunakan kode aplikasi di task.

options.text: The ECS task IAM role used by the application.
options.explanation: Task role adalah identitas panggilan AWS yang dibuat kode di dalam task.

options.text: An EC2 instance profile attached to a Fargate host managed by the customer.
options.explanation: Customer tidak memasang instance profile ke host Fargate.

question: A Lambda function reads objects only from the reports/ prefix of one S3 bucket. It never lists the bucket or writes objects. Which permission design best follows least privilege?

options.text: Allow s3:* on every S3 resource in the function execution role.
options.explanation: Semua action dan semua bucket jauh lebih luas dari kebutuhan.

options.text: Allow s3:ListBucket on the bucket ARN and omit object-read permissions.
options.explanation: ListBucket tidak memberi GetObject untuk membaca isi objek.

options.text: Allow s3:GetObject on the reports/* object ARN in the function execution role.
options.explanation: Action dan ARN objek dibatasi tepat pada operasi dan prefix yang diminta.

options.text: Allow s3:GetObject on the bucket ARN without its object path.
options.explanation: GetObject memerlukan resource objek, bukan hanya ARN bucket.

question: A deployment role in account A must assume a release role in account B. There are no organization guardrails or explicit denies blocking the operation. Which actions are required? Select TWO.

options.text: Attach the deployment role policy to an unrelated group in account B instead of configuring the release role.
options.explanation: Policy pada principal lain tidak memenuhi kebutuhan authorization pemanggil dan trust role target.

options.text: Allow the account A deployment role to call sts:AssumeRole on the release role ARN.
options.explanation: Caller perlu izin melakukan operasi AssumeRole terhadap target.

options.text: Configure the release role trust policy to trust the deployment role in account A.
options.explanation: Role tujuan harus menerima principal yang mengambil sesi.

options.text: Give the account A role permission to list roles in account B but not to assume the release role.
options.explanation: ListRoles bukan izin AssumeRole dan tidak membentuk hubungan trust.

options.text: Put sts:AssumeRole only in the release role permissions policy and omit its trust relationship.
options.explanation: Permissions policy role tujuan bukan pengganti trust policy yang menentukan siapa dapat mengasumsikan role.

question: A monitoring vendor serves many customers from the same AWS account. It must assume a read-only role in your account, and you need protection against another vendor customer causing that role to be used on their behalf. Which design is appropriate?

options.text: Allow every AWS account to assume the role if it knows the role ARN.
options.explanation: Role ARN bukan rahasia pengganti trust yang dibatasi.

options.text: Trust the vendor account and let any of its customers choose the same role session name.
options.explanation: Session name bukan pembatas confused deputy yang diminta.

options.text: Share a read-only IAM user access key and omit role-based access.
options.explanation: Key bersama menambah kredensial permanen dan tidak memecahkan delegasi per pelanggan.

options.text: Trust the vendor principal and require the customer-specific external ID supplied by the vendor.
options.explanation: External ID mengikat permintaan vendor ke pelanggan yang dimaksud.

question: A partner can already assume a role in your account. That role must read only objects under partner-a/ in a bucket owned by your account. The objects use SSE-S3, and no resource policy or explicit deny changes the authorization. Which permissions policy should the assumed role receive?

options.text: Allow s3:GetObject on every bucket in your account because the trust policy already names the partner.
options.explanation: Trust membatasi siapa yang dapat mengasumsikan role, bukan otomatis membatasi resource yang boleh diakses sesudahnya.

options.text: Add s3:GetObject to the trust policy and leave the role without an applicable permissions policy.
options.explanation: Trust policy mengatur asumsi role; permission operasi S3 harus diberikan melalui mekanisme authorization yang berlaku, bukan mengganti purpose trust policy.

options.text: Allow s3:GetObject on the bucket's partner-a/* object ARN only.
options.explanation: Permissions role yang diasumsikan membatasi operasi sesudah AssumeRole. GetObject pada prefix tersebut memberikan cakupan baca yang diminta.

options.text: Allow s3:ListBucket on the bucket but grant no object-read permission.
options.explanation: ListBucket memberi daftar object keys, bukan membaca isi objek melalui GetObject.

question: A company must prevent ordinary IAM administrators in its organization's member accounts from disabling CloudTrail trails. Administrators must retain other permitted actions. Which control should the company use?

options.text: Use an AWS Config rule to detect disabled trails, without any preventive deny.
options.explanation: Detective compliance dapat melaporkan perubahan tetapi tidak mencegah API disable dijalankan oleh administrator.

options.text: Attach an additional Allow policy for CloudTrail to every administrator.
options.explanation: Allow tambahan tidak mencegah operasi yang tidak diinginkan.

options.text: Apply an SCP that explicitly denies the relevant CloudTrail disable and delete operations in the member accounts.
options.explanation: Guardrail organisasi membatasi admin IAM akun anggota meskipun identity policy mereka luas.

options.text: Attach a read-only policy to administrators while leaving their broader administrator permissions in place.
options.explanation: Tambahan Allow yang sempit tidak membatalkan Allow luas; explicit deny guardrail yang berlaku diperlukan untuk pencegahan ini.

question: A platform team lets developers create IAM roles for applications in one account. The developers must not grant those roles permissions outside an approved maximum policy. Which approach is most appropriate?

options.text: Create an SCP Allow statement and assume it grants only the approved actions to every role.
options.explanation: SCP tidak memberi izin, dan masalah delegasi role memerlukan kontrol yang tepat.

options.text: Require the approved permissions boundary on created roles and prevent developers from changing or removing it.
options.explanation: Boundary membatasi izin yang didelegasikan; kontrol pemasangan dan perubahan mencegah bypass.

options.text: Attach a permissions boundary to the developer role only and assume every newly created role inherits it.
options.explanation: Boundary pada creator tidak otomatis diwariskan ke role baru; enforcement pada create dan perubahan boundary diperlukan.

options.text: Require the approved boundary only in a deployment checklist while still permitting developers to remove it.
options.explanation: Kontrol prosedural yang dapat dilewati tidak menegakkan maksimum permission; penghapusan atau penggantian boundary harus dibatasi.

question: An IAM role has an identity policy allowing an S3 action. An applicable SCP explicitly denies that same action. The request does not involve the management account or an exempt service-linked role. What is the result?

options.text: The request is allowed because the role policy is evaluated more recently.
options.explanation: Urutan waktu penulisan policy bukan aturan untuk mengalahkan deny.

options.text: The request is allowed because an applicable identity-based Allow always overrides an SCP Deny.
options.explanation: Explicit deny yang berlaku tidak dapat dikalahkan dengan identity Allow.

options.text: The request is denied; adding another identity-based Allow does not override the applicable Deny.
options.explanation: Deny yang berlaku membatasi izin role dalam konteks soal.

options.text: The request is allowed if the role session is temporary rather than a long-term IAM user session.
options.explanation: Temporary credentials tidak mengecualikan role dari guardrail yang berlaku.

question: Private EC2 instances need to read S3 objects in the same Region. They have no internet gateway or NAT route, and access is needed only from this VPC. Which option provides the required path with no additional endpoint charge?

options.text: Create an S3 interface endpoint and assume it has no hourly or data-processing endpoint charge.
options.explanation: Interface endpoint dapat memberi konektivitas pada skenario yang sesuai, tetapi model biayanya berbeda dari gateway endpoint gratis yang diminta.

options.text: Add a public S3 bucket policy without changing the VPC routing.
options.explanation: Policy tidak membangun jalur jaringan yang belum tersedia.

options.text: Create an S3 gateway endpoint and associate it with the instances' subnet route tables.
options.explanation: Gateway endpoint cocok untuk akses S3 dari VPC tanpa NAT dan tanpa biaya endpoint tambahan.

options.text: Deploy a public NAT gateway solely for S3 traffic.
options.explanation: NAT bisa memberi jalur, tetapi menambah biaya dan tidak diperlukan untuk syarat ini.

question: An application in private subnets must retrieve Secrets Manager secrets without internet access. Its IAM permissions are already correct. Which configuration should provide private connectivity?

options.text: Create an S3 gateway endpoint and route Secrets Manager requests through its prefix list.
options.explanation: Gateway endpoint S3 tidak melayani API Secrets Manager.

options.text: Add secretsmanager:GetSecretValue to the application role again and leave networking unchanged.
options.explanation: Masalahnya jaringan; izin tambahan tidak menciptakan konektivitas.

options.text: Create a Secrets Manager interface endpoint but leave its security group blocking inbound HTTPS from the application.
options.explanation: Endpoint harus mengizinkan koneksi HTTPS dari client yang benar; keberadaan ENI saja tidak cukup.

options.text: Create a Secrets Manager interface endpoint, enable private DNS, and permit HTTPS from the application in the endpoint security group.
options.explanation: Interface endpoint, DNS, dan izin jaringan membentuk jalur privat ke API Secrets Manager.

question: A vendor exposes a TCP service from its VPC. Customer VPC CIDR ranges may overlap with the vendor's ranges. Customers should reach only this service, not receive full routed access to the vendor network. Which design fits?

options.text: Connect the overlapping customer and vendor VPCs through route-table entries alone, without translation or a service endpoint.
options.explanation: Route tables saja tidak mengatasi CIDR overlap dan tidak menyediakan service-scoped access yang diminta.

options.text: Create VPC peering connections even when the CIDR ranges overlap.
options.explanation: Peering tidak menyelesaikan alamat CIDR yang tumpang tindih.

options.text: Attach every VPC to a shared transit gateway and advertise all overlapping routes unchanged.
options.explanation: Routing luas dengan CIDR overlap bukan isolasi layanan yang diminta.

options.text: Publish a PrivateLink endpoint service behind a Network Load Balancer and let customers create interface endpoints.
options.explanation: PrivateLink memberi akses ke layanan tanpa merangkai seluruh routing CIDR kedua VPC.

question: A web application and an RDS PostgreSQL database are in the same VPC. Application instance IP addresses change frequently. The database should accept port 5432 only from the application tier. What should the database security group allow?

options.text: Inbound all traffic from the entire VPC CIDR.
options.explanation: Ini juga mengizinkan tier lain dan port yang tidak dibutuhkan.

options.text: Inbound TCP 5432 with the application security group as the source.
options.explanation: Referensi grup mengikuti instance aplikasi tanpa membuka seluruh subnet.

options.text: Inbound TCP 443 from the load balancer security group.
options.explanation: Port dan sumber itu tidak sesuai koneksi aplikasi ke PostgreSQL.

options.text: Inbound TCP 5432 from 0.0.0.0/0.
options.explanation: Sumber global jauh lebih luas dari tier aplikasi.

question: A subnet must immediately reject traffic from one known external IPv4 CIDR while continuing to allow other permitted traffic. Which subnet-level control can express this explicit deny?

options.text: A network ACL deny rule evaluated before a broader matching allow rule.
options.explanation: ACL dapat menolak CIDR tertentu dan urutan rule menentukan kecocokan pertama.

options.text: A security group rule with a Deny action for the CIDR.
options.explanation: Security group tidak memiliki rule Deny eksplisit.

options.text: Configure an outbound-only network ACL deny for traffic that must be rejected on its inbound path.
options.explanation: ACL dievaluasi per arah; rule outbound-only bukan explicit inbound block yang diminta.

options.text: Remove one allow rule from a security group while another rule still allows the same CIDR.
options.explanation: Security group permissions bersifat agregat allow; menghapus satu Allow tidak membuat explicit deny yang mengalahkan Allow lainnya.

question: A custom network ACL permits inbound HTTPS to EC2 web servers but has no rule permitting outbound response traffic. Security groups and routes are correct. Which change addresses the missing return path?

options.text: Assume the network ACL automatically permits established connections because security groups are stateful.
options.explanation: Security groups stateful tidak mengubah network ACL yang stateless; aturan return path tetap diperlukan.

options.text: Add a second inbound HTTPS allow rule to the same ACL.
options.explanation: Aturan inbound tambahan tidak mengizinkan arah outbound.

options.text: Increase the ALB idle timeout but leave the network ACL response path blocked.
options.explanation: Menunggu lebih lama tidak membuka jalur outbound response yang ditolak ACL.

options.text: Allow the appropriate outbound response traffic to client ephemeral ports in the network ACL.
options.explanation: ACL stateless memerlukan izin eksplisit untuk paket balasan.

question: A public application behind an ALB receives requests containing SQL injection patterns in query strings. The team needs managed HTTP filtering without modifying application code. Which control should it add?

options.text: Enable Shield Standard and assume it provides the requested SQL-injection web ACL rules.
options.explanation: Perlindungan DDoS default bukan pengganti konfigurasi WAF untuk filtering SQL-injection patterns.

options.text: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the ALB and enable appropriate managed rules.
options.explanation: WAF dapat memeriksa konten HTTP yang tidak terlihat oleh filter port.

options.text: Replace the ALB security group with an inbound rule allowing only TCP 443.
options.explanation: Request berbahaya juga bisa datang melalui HTTPS yang diizinkan.

options.text: Enable GuardDuty findings but add no request-filtering control to the ALB.
options.explanation: Threat detection bukan pengganti blocking HTTP payload yang dilakukan WAF pada request path.

question: A login endpoint behind CloudFront is receiving excessive requests from individual client IP addresses. The team wants to limit matching HTTP requests at the edge, not impose an exact billing quota. Which configuration fits?

options.text: Use only a network ACL rule matching the HTTP URL path.
options.explanation: ACL jaringan tidak memeriksa path HTTP.

options.text: Use a static WAF IP block list that never evaluates request rates.
options.explanation: Daftar statis dapat memblokir IP tertentu tetapi tidak menegakkan deteksi/pembatasan berdasarkan rate yang diminta.

options.text: Apply a WAF rate-based rule globally without limiting it to the login path.
options.explanation: Rule global tidak mempertahankan scope login; traffic endpoint lain ikut dihitung dan dapat dibatasi.

options.text: Use an AWS WAF rate-based rule scoped to the login path and aggregate by client IP.
options.explanation: Rule dapat memusatkan pembatasan pada endpoint dan kelompok IP yang dimaksud.

question: A company already uses standard AWS DDoS protections. It now needs an enhanced managed DDoS protection service for eligible internet-facing resources, including specialized response capabilities subject to AWS prerequisites. Which service should it evaluate?

options.text: Network ACL rules alone, with no enhanced managed DDoS protection subscription.
options.explanation: ACL memfilter jaringan tetapi tidak menyediakan layanan respons DDoS enhanced tersebut.

options.text: AWS Shield Advanced.
options.explanation: Shield Advanced menambahkan kemampuan deteksi, mitigasi, dan respons DDoS.

options.text: Amazon GuardDuty alone to block volumetric attacks and provide enhanced DDoS response entitlements.
options.explanation: GuardDuty merupakan threat detection, bukan pengganti Shield Advanced protection/response entitlements.

options.text: AWS WAF alone as a replacement for all enhanced DDoS response-service capabilities.
options.explanation: WAF membantu filtering web traffic, tetapi bukan pengganti paket enhanced DDoS response yang dimaksud Shield Advanced.

question: An application uses a database password that must rotate automatically. The team wants a managed secret store with supported rotation integration rather than a custom scheduler and encrypted text file. Which solution should it choose?

options.text: Update the stored secret on a schedule without updating the database credential.
options.explanation: Rotasi perlu menjaga konsistensi nilai credential antara secret store dan database; mengganti satu sisi saja merusak login.

options.text: Encrypt the password once with KMS and assume key rotation changes the database password.
options.explanation: Rotasi key enkripsi bukan rotasi password database.

options.text: Store the password in a SecureString parameter and assume Parameter Store automatically changes the database password.
options.explanation: SecureString memberi penyimpanan terenkripsi, bukan rotasi otomatis credential database tanpa orchestration yang sesuai.

options.text: Store the credential in Secrets Manager and configure rotation that updates both the secret and database.
options.explanation: Rotasi yang benar menjaga konsistensi credential pada kedua sisi.

question: A service needs centrally stored, versioned configuration values under /production/api/. One value must be encrypted, but none require automatic credential rotation. Which option directly matches this lightweight configuration use case?

options.text: Put the values in each container image and redeploy all images whenever configuration changes.
options.explanation: Konfigurasi terikat image bukan central versioned parameter store yang diminta dan menambah deployment work.

options.text: Systems Manager Parameter Store with String and SecureString parameters as appropriate.
options.explanation: Hierarki, versi, dan SecureString sesuai konfigurasi yang tidak memerlukan rotasi otomatis.

options.text: Use an S3 object as configuration and rely on the object key alone to provide Parameter Store-style hierarchy and version APIs.
options.explanation: S3 dapat menyimpan file konfigurasi, tetapi pilihan ini tidak langsung menyediakan parameter API/tipe SecureString dan hierarchy yang diminta.

options.text: Use a single plain String parameter for every value, including the one that must be encrypted.
options.explanation: Plain String tidak memenuhi kebutuhan penyimpanan encrypted value; gunakan tipe yang sesuai.

question: A team selects an RDS engine and version that support RDS-managed master passwords in Secrets Manager. It wants AWS to manage password generation and rotation for that master credential. What should it do?

options.text: Enable RDS management of the master password in Secrets Manager and grant only necessary secret access.
options.explanation: Integrasi RDS mengelola secret master; akses pembaca secret tetap perlu dibatasi.

options.text: Rotate the KMS key and keep the database password permanently unchanged.
options.explanation: Rotasi key tidak mengganti password database.

options.text: Create a customer Lambda rotation function because every Secrets Manager rotation requires one.
options.explanation: Tidak semua rotasi menggunakan Lambda; ada managed rotation oleh layanan.

options.text: Change only the database password manually and leave the stored secret unchanged.
options.explanation: Kedua sisi menjadi tidak sinkron; opsi ini juga tidak memenuhi pengelolaan AWS untuk generation dan rotation.

question: A consumer web application needs self-service registration, sign-in, and federation with social identity providers. Users will call the company's backend API, not administer AWS accounts. Which service best fits authentication?

options.text: An Amazon Cognito user pool.
options.explanation: User pool menangani direktori dan autentikasi pengguna aplikasi.

options.text: IAM Identity Center account assignments for every consumer.
options.explanation: Assignment workforce bukan pola utama login konsumen aplikasi.

options.text: A Cognito identity pool alone, treated as the user directory and registration service.
options.explanation: Identity pool memberi credential federation, bukan pengganti user-pool directory untuk fitur sign-up/sign-in tersebut.

options.text: An IAM user for each consumer, with IAM user creation exposed as the public registration flow.
options.explanation: IAM users berorientasi AWS account/service identities dan bukan pilihan yang tepat untuk self-service consumer authentication ini.

question: Mobile users authenticate through a Cognito user pool. The application must then call AWS APIs directly with temporary credentials scoped to each user's allowed resources. What should be added?

options.text: An additional user pool without any AWS credential exchange or IAM roles.
options.explanation: Pool login tambahan tidak menyelesaikan kebutuhan temporary AWS credentials.

options.text: Send the user-pool JWT directly as an AWS access-key ID when signing S3 requests.
options.explanation: JWT bukan AWS access-key ID; panggilan AWS API memerlukan credential/signing flow yang didukung.

options.text: A Cognito identity pool with appropriately scoped IAM roles.
options.explanation: Identity pool menukar identitas federasi menjadi credential AWS sementara.

options.text: Use the same unrestricted IAM role for every user and omit resource scoping.
options.explanation: Shared unrestricted permissions tidak memenuhi kebutuhan credential yang scoped ke resource yang boleh diakses user.

question: An authenticated mobile application writes files directly to S3 using a Cognito identity pool. Each user must access only that user's assigned prefix. Which design enforces this requirement at the service boundary?

options.text: Attach a policy that allows all prefixes and put the user identifier only in an object tag not referenced by any authorization rule.
options.explanation: Metadata tanpa kondisi policy yang menegakkannya bukan pembatas akses; bucket-wide Allow tetap terlalu luas.

options.text: Restrict only ListBucket results while permitting GetObject and PutObject across the entire bucket.
options.explanation: Membatasi listing tidak membatasi operasi objek jika object permissions tetap luas.

options.text: Use scoped IAM permissions that restrict the federated identity to its assigned S3 prefix.
options.explanation: Batas diterapkan saat AWS mengotorisasi request, bukan hanya pada tampilan aplikasi.

options.text: Grant bucket-wide access and hide other users' files in the mobile interface.
options.explanation: UI dapat dilewati; credential masih memiliki hak bucket-wide.

question: A company stores sensitive documents in S3. Its security team needs control over the encryption key policy and a separation between key administrators and applications that decrypt data. Which approach best supports these requirements?

options.text: Use SSE-S3 and assume the company can edit the underlying S3-managed encryption key policy.
options.explanation: SSE-S3 tidak memberi customer-managed KMS key policy yang dibutuhkan untuk kontrol administrasi tersebut.

options.text: Give every key administrator kms:* and claim this prevents those administrators from decrypting.
options.explanation: Izin wildcard tidak memisahkan administrasi dari penggunaan key.

options.text: Use the AWS managed S3 KMS key and assume its key policy is fully editable by the company.
options.explanation: Kebutuhan kontrol key policy oleh customer sesuai dengan customer managed key, bukan asumsi policy AWS managed key bebas diedit.

options.text: Use SSE-KMS with a customer managed key and separate key-administration permissions from decrypt permissions.
options.explanation: Customer managed key memungkinkan policy spesifik dan pemisahan fungsi.

question: A role has an IAM Allow for kms:Decrypt on a customer managed key in the same account. The key policy neither authorizes that role nor enables IAM policies to grant access, and no grant applies. Why is decrypt denied?

options.text: Allowing S3 GetObject automatically overrides any missing KMS authorization.
options.explanation: Izin object-read S3 tidak menggantikan authorization terhadap KMS key.

options.text: The role must rotate the key before any IAM policy can ever grant decryption.
options.explanation: Rotasi bukan syarat membentuk authorization; key policy/grant dan IAM policy yang berlaku adalah fokusnya.

options.text: The key policy has not established an applicable authorization path for that role.
options.explanation: IAM Allow harus didukung jalur otorisasi KMS yang sesuai; kondisi soal meniadakannya.

options.text: The key alias must be renamed to match the role name before decrypt is authorized.
options.explanation: Penamaan alias bukan mekanisme yang otomatis memberi authorization dekripsi.

question: A role in account B reads SSE-KMS objects from account A. S3 access is already configured. Which actions establish KMS decryption access, assuming no explicit deny? Select TWO.

options.text: Allow the required KMS decrypt operation on that key in the account B role's IAM policy.
options.explanation: Akun pemanggil juga mendelegasikan operasi decrypt pada key tujuan.

options.text: Permit only kms:DescribeKey on the key instead of decrypt.
options.explanation: Melihat metadata key bukan izin untuk dekripsi ciphertext.

options.text: Permit the account B role to use the key in account A's customer managed KMS key policy.
options.explanation: Pemilik key mengotorisasi principal eksternal yang tepat.

options.text: Grant only s3:GetObject in account B and treat that as sufficient KMS authorization.
options.explanation: S3 authorization sudah ada pada soal dan tidak menggantikan KMS authorization lintas account.

options.text: Add an IAM Allow in account A to an unrelated local role instead of allowing the account B role.
options.explanation: Authorization principal lokal yang berbeda tidak memberikan role account B jalur KMS yang diperlukan.

question: A company serves private S3 objects through CloudFront. Users must not bypass CloudFront by requesting the S3 object URL directly. Which origin configuration should it use?

options.text: Configure a CloudFront cache policy while leaving the S3 bucket policy open to direct public reads.
options.explanation: Cache policy tidak membatasi bypass akses langsung ke bucket; origin access permissions harus diatur.

options.text: Add signed viewer URLs while leaving the bucket publicly readable.
options.explanation: Viewer signing tidak menutup jalur langsung ke bucket publik.

options.text: Use an S3 bucket origin with OAC and a bucket policy allowing the intended CloudFront distribution.
options.explanation: OAC dan bucket policy membatasi akses origin pada distribusi yang dipilih.

options.text: Use the S3 website endpoint with OAC and keep all objects publicly readable.
options.explanation: Website endpoint tidak mendukung OAC dan objek publik dapat diakses langsung.

question: A backend authorizes a user to download one private S3 object for a short period. The user should not receive AWS credentials or bucket-wide access. Which solution is appropriate?

options.text: Return a presigned GET URL for a different object prefix than the one the backend authorized.
options.explanation: Scope yang ditandatangani harus sesuai object yang diotorisasi, bukan memberi akses objek lain.

options.text: Return a presigned PUT URL for the object when the user only needs to download it.
options.explanation: Method yang ditandatangani harus sesuai operasi; PUT bukan izin GET untuk download.

options.text: Return a short-lived presigned GET URL generated by an authorized backend role.
options.explanation: URL membatasi operasi dan objek, dengan masa berlaku yang ditentukan.

options.text: Grant the user ListBucket but no permission to read object contents.
options.explanation: Listing bukan download konten; kebutuhan akses satu objek belum terpenuhi.

question: A subscription site uses CloudFront to deliver hundreds of private media segments per video. It wants to authorize a subscriber for the related files without changing every segment URL. Which viewer-access mechanism fits?

options.text: Use one signed URL for the video manifest and assume it authorizes every unmodified segment request automatically.
options.explanation: Authorization satu URL manifest tidak otomatis memberi hak pada semua URL segment yang diambil secara terpisah.

options.text: CloudFront signed cookies with an appropriately scoped policy.
options.explanation: Cookie dapat mencakup sekumpulan file tanpa menambahkan signature ke tiap URL.

options.text: Generate a separate signed URL for every segment and rewrite every segment reference.
options.explanation: Cara ini dapat memberi akses bertanda tangan, tetapi melanggar tujuan tidak perlu mengubah setiap segment URL.

options.text: Only origin access control, with no viewer authorization.
options.explanation: OAC membatasi origin access, bukan menentukan siapa subscriber yang sah.

question: A company must keep specific S3 object versions unchanged for seven years. No user, including the account root user, may shorten retention or permanently delete those protected versions during that period. Which configuration meets this requirement?

options.text: S3 Versioning alone with administrator delete permissions.
options.explanation: Versioning saja tidak mencegah permanent delete pada versi tertentu.

options.text: An S3 Lifecycle expiration rule set to one year.
options.explanation: Expiration satu tahun bertentangan dengan retention tujuh tahun.

options.text: S3 Object Lock in governance mode with broad bypass permissions.
options.explanation: Governance dapat dilewati oleh principal yang diberi izin bypass.

options.text: S3 Object Lock in compliance mode with the required retention period.
options.explanation: Compliance mode sesuai larangan bypass selama masa retention.

question: Documents in S3 must remain protected until an investigation finishes. The end date is unknown, and authorized staff will explicitly release the protection later. Which feature best matches this lifecycle?

options.text: Enable S3 Versioning without restricting permanent version deletion by authorized administrators.
options.explanation: Versioning bukan legal hold; permanent deletion tetap mungkin jika permission mengizinkan.

options.text: Use a bucket lifecycle rule to delete objects automatically when their last-access timestamp changes.
options.explanation: Lifecycle deletion bukan hold dengan release manual oleh staf berwenang; rule tersebut tidak mewakili kebutuhan investigasi.

options.text: Set a short fixed retention period and assume protection remains indefinitely after it expires.
options.explanation: Fixed period tidak sesuai release eksplisit dengan tanggal akhir yang belum diketahui; setelah periode berakhir jaminan itu tidak berlanjut otomatis.

options.text: An S3 Object Lock legal hold on the relevant object versions.
options.explanation: Legal hold tetap berlaku sampai dilepas secara eksplisit oleh pihak berizin.

question: A developer overwrites an S3 object. The bucket had versioning enabled, previous versions were retained, and no permanent version deletion occurred. What is the simplest recovery approach?

options.text: Retrieve the previous object version and restore it as the current content if needed.
options.explanation: Versi lama masih ada sehingga recovery tidak perlu membangun ulang bucket.

options.text: Disable versioning and expect S3 to reconstruct overwritten bytes automatically.
options.explanation: Menonaktifkan versioning tidak memilih versi lama sebagai current.

options.text: Enable replication only after the overwrite and assume it recreates the missing earlier content.
options.explanation: Replication baru tidak merekonstruksi histori yang hilang; previous version yang sudah ada adalah sumber recovery langsung.

options.text: Delete all noncurrent versions and then request restoration of the overwritten bytes.
options.explanation: Menghapus versi lama justru membuang sumber recovery yang masih tersedia.

question: A company has thousands of S3 objects and needs to discover which supported objects contain personal information. It wants managed classification rather than writing its own scanning engine. Which service should it use?

options.text: Amazon Macie.
options.explanation: Macie dirancang untuk discovery data sensitif pada S3.

options.text: AWS Config resource configuration rules only.
options.explanation: Config mengevaluasi konfigurasi resource, bukan pengganti klasifikasi isi objek sensitif oleh Macie.

options.text: AWS CloudTrail management events only.
options.explanation: Riwayat API tidak membaca isi objek untuk klasifikasi PII.

options.text: Amazon Inspector software vulnerability scans only.
options.explanation: Inspector berfokus pada vulnerabilities/exposure workload yang didukung, bukan klasifikasi PII dalam objek S3.

question: Auditors need records of GetObject and PutObject calls for a sensitive S3 bucket. The company currently records only CloudTrail management events. Which change addresses the missing object-level audit records?

options.text: Enable only AWS Config history for bucket configuration changes.
options.explanation: Riwayat konfigurasi bucket tidak merekam setiap object API access yang diminta auditor.

options.text: Configure CloudTrail S3 data events for the relevant bucket and operations.
options.explanation: GetObject dan PutObject termasuk operasi data plane yang perlu logging data event.

options.text: Enable only S3 Versioning and assume it logs all reads.
options.explanation: Versioning menyimpan versi objek, bukan riwayat setiap pembacaan.

options.text: Enable additional CloudTrail management events but leave S3 data events disabled.
options.explanation: Object-level GetObject/PutObject perlu data events; memperluas management events tidak menggantikannya.

question: A security team wants managed detection of suspicious AWS credential use and potentially malicious workload activity based on supported AWS data sources. It does not want to build its own threat-analysis pipeline. Which service fits?

options.text: Amazon Macie alone for every EC2 and IAM threat.
options.explanation: Macie berfokus pada data sensitif S3, bukan pengganti seluruh threat detection.

options.text: AWS Config compliance rules alone.
options.explanation: Evaluasi konfigurasi bukan pengganti analisis ancaman GuardDuty atas data sumber yang didukung.

options.text: Amazon GuardDuty.
options.explanation: GuardDuty menganalisis sumber data yang didukung untuk mendeteksi ancaman.

options.text: Amazon Inspector vulnerability scans alone.
options.explanation: Vulnerability scanning bukan managed behavioral threat detection atas credential use dan activity yang dijelaskan.

question: A company has a Direct Connect connection but must also encrypt traffic between its on-premises network and AWS using IPsec. Which approach meets this requirement?

options.text: Enable encryption at rest on the destination storage without encrypting the network path.
options.explanation: Enkripsi storage tidak melindungi traffic in transit di jalur hybrid.

options.text: Assume every Direct Connect circuit is already IPsec-encrypted by default.
options.explanation: Private connectivity bukan bukti enkripsi IPsec.

options.text: Configure a supported Site-to-Site VPN over the Direct Connect connectivity.
options.explanation: VPN menambahkan enkripsi IPsec; Direct Connect sendiri tidak mengenkripsi secara default.

options.text: Use MACsec alone and assume link-layer encryption is the required end-to-end IPsec tunnel.
options.explanation: MACsec dan IPsec memiliki layer/cakupan berbeda; kebutuhan eksplisit IPsec harus dipenuhi oleh desain yang mendukungnya.

question: Remote employees using laptops need authenticated access to private applications in a VPC from changing locations. The company wants a managed client-based VPN rather than maintaining a VPN server. Which service should it select?

options.text: An EC2-hosted VPN appliance that the company must patch and maintain.
options.explanation: Appliance dapat membangun VPN tetapi tidak memenuhi keinginan menghindari pengelolaan server VPN.

options.text: AWS Site-to-Site VPN configured to a single office gateway as the only roaming-laptop client-access mechanism.
options.explanation: Site-to-Site menghubungkan jaringan/gateway; kebutuhan client berbasis identitas dari lokasi berubah lebih sesuai Client VPN.

options.text: PrivateLink interface endpoints without any remote-client network connection or authentication flow.
options.explanation: PrivateLink menyediakan service connectivity privat, bukan pengganti client VPN dari internet ke private network.

options.text: AWS Client VPN.
options.explanation: Client VPN melayani perangkat pengguna dengan koneksi VPN terkelola.

question: Administrators need shell access to private EC2 instances without public IP addresses, bastion hosts, or inbound SSH rules. Instances can reach the required Systems Manager endpoints. Which additional components are required? Select TWO.

options.text: A running, supported SSM Agent and an appropriate managed-node IAM role on the instances.
options.explanation: Instance harus terdaftar dan memiliki izin sebagai managed node.

options.text: IAM permissions that authorize administrators to start the required Session Manager sessions.
options.explanation: Operator juga harus diberi izin memulai sesi ke node yang sesuai.

options.text: Only an EC2 SSH key pair, with no SSM Agent or managed-node permissions.
options.explanation: SSH key pair bukan komponen Session Manager yang menggantikan agent dan IAM authorization.

options.text: A public Elastic IP for every instance.
options.explanation: Konektivitas endpoint tersedia tanpa public IP instance.

options.text: An inbound security group rule allowing port 22 from the entire internet.
options.explanation: Syaratnya justru tanpa inbound SSH.

question: An application requires the original TLS connection to terminate on its EC2 servers, not on the load balancer. Layer 7 routing is not required. Which listener design meets this requirement?

options.text: An ALB HTTPS listener that terminates client TLS and establishes a separate HTTPS connection to targets.
options.explanation: TLS re-encryption tetap mengakhiri koneksi TLS asli pada ALB; soal mensyaratkan original TLS connection sampai ke server.

options.text: A Network Load Balancer TCP listener on port 443 that forwards to the application servers.
options.explanation: TCP passthrough mempertahankan terminasi TLS pada server.

options.text: An ALB HTTPS listener that decrypts requests before forwarding HTTP.
options.explanation: ALB HTTPS mengakhiri TLS di load balancer.

options.text: An NLB TLS listener with the application certificate installed on the load balancer.
options.explanation: TLS listener melakukan terminasi pada NLB, bukan passthrough murni.

source.title: ALB HTTPS listeners and TCP passthrough

question: A CloudFront distribution will serve https://learn.example.com using an ACM-issued public certificate for viewer connections. In which Region should the certificate be requested?

options.text: US East (N. Virginia), us-east-1.
options.explanation: CloudFront memakai ACM certificate viewer dari us-east-1.

options.text: Only the Region containing the S3 origin, regardless of CloudFront requirements.
options.explanation: Region origin bukan aturan untuk sertifikat viewer CloudFront.

options.text: Only the Region nearest to the first viewer.
options.explanation: Lokasi viewer tidak menentukan Region certificate CloudFront.

options.text: A different Region for every CloudFront edge location.
options.explanation: Tidak perlu sertifikat terpisah per edge location.

question: An S3 bucket already encrypts objects at rest. A security requirement additionally forbids requests over unencrypted HTTP. Which control directly enforces the transport requirement?

options.text: Require only SSE-KMS encryption headers on uploads without evaluating the transport condition.
options.explanation: Header enkripsi at-rest tidak mencegah request HTTP; transport harus dievaluasi terpisah.

options.text: Rotate the KMS key more frequently but leave HTTP access allowed.
options.explanation: Rotasi key at rest tidak melarang koneksi HTTP.

options.text: Enable S3 Block Public Access and assume authenticated HTTP requests are therefore forbidden.
options.explanation: Pembatasan public access bukan kondisi transport; request authenticated tetap perlu pembatasan HTTPS yang diminta.

options.text: A bucket policy explicitly denying requests when aws:SecureTransport is false, with required service-principal exceptions considered.
options.explanation: Policy menolak transport yang tidak aman; enkripsi objek tidak cukup.

question: A developer role has an identity policy allowing s3:GetObject on a project bucket. The bucket policy explicitly denies this role access to the confidential prefix. No other policy affects the request. What happens when the role reads an object in that prefix?

options.text: The request succeeds because the role and bucket are in the same account.
options.explanation: Satu akun tidak menghapus efek explicit deny pada resource.

options.text: The request succeeds if AdministratorAccess is attached to the role.
options.explanation: AdministratorAccess tetap tunduk pada explicit deny yang berlaku.

options.text: The request succeeds because identity policies are evaluated before bucket policies.
options.explanation: Urutan yang dibayangkan ini bukan aturan prioritas; semua kebijakan yang relevan ikut dievaluasi.

options.text: The request is denied because the applicable explicit deny overrides the allow.
options.explanation: Deny yang berlaku tetap menang; menambah izin Allow tidak meniadakannya.

question: A platform team lets developers create application roles. Every new role must remain within an approved permission boundary, and developers must not remove that boundary. Which delegation design meets the requirement?

options.text: Add the approved policy as an optional inline policy on each application role.
options.explanation: Inline allow tambahan tidak membatasi allow yang lebih luas dari kebijakan lain.

options.text: Attach the approved policy to the developers but allow unrestricted creation of new roles.
options.explanation: Izin developer tidak otomatis menjadi batas untuk role yang dibuatnya.

options.text: Use resource tags alone without authorization conditions or restrictions on tag changes.
options.explanation: Tag tanpa aturan izin dan tata kelola bukan kontrol otorisasi.

options.text: Require the approved permissions boundary during role creation and restrict changing or deleting it.
options.explanation: Boundary membatasi izin berbasis identitas; proteksi perubahan mencegah developer melepas batas tersebut.

question: Teams create many project resources in services that support tag-based authorization. Staff should access only resources whose Project tag matches their principal tag. Which approach scales authorization while reducing policy rewrites?

options.text: Grant access to all resources and use Project tags only in billing reports.
options.explanation: Tag biaya tanpa kondisi IAM tidak membatasi akses.

options.text: Let each employee set any Project principal tag before making requests.
options.explanation: Pengguna dapat memilih proyek lain dan menaikkan aksesnya sendiri.

options.text: Use ABAC conditions comparing the tags and tightly control who can assign or change authorization tags.
options.explanation: Perbandingan atribut menghindari daftar ARN yang terus berubah; perubahan tag harus dilindungi.

options.text: Create a separate AWS account for every resource to eliminate all permission policies.
options.explanation: Isolasi akun tidak menghilangkan kebutuhan otorisasi dan berlebihan untuk kebutuhan ini.

question: A role allows reading and writing a bucket. An application assumes the role with a session policy allowing only reads. No resource policy grants additional access and no other restriction applies. What can that session do?

options.text: Read the permitted objects but not write them.
options.explanation: Session policy mempersempit izin role; operasi tulis tidak berada dalam irisan izin.

options.text: Read and write because the role policy always overrides a session policy.
options.explanation: Session policy membatasi sesi, bukan sekadar dokumentasi.

options.text: Write but not read because session policies list denied operations.
options.explanation: Dokumen yang diberikan adalah allow untuk baca, bukan daftar deny.

options.text: Access other buckets because session policies can add permissions to a role.
options.explanation: Session policy tidak dapat memperluas izin role asal.

question: An external CI service issues signed OIDC tokens identifying the repository and deployment environment. Only production jobs from one repository may deploy to AWS. How should the company avoid storing long-lived AWS access keys?

options.text: Store an IAM user key in every build artifact and rotate it quarterly.
options.explanation: Masih menyimpan kredensial jangka panjang di tempat yang berisiko tersebar.

options.text: Trust every subject from the CI provider because its tokens are signed.
options.explanation: Tanda tangan membuktikan penerbit, bukan bahwa semua repositori berwenang.

options.text: Attach an EC2 instance profile to the external CI service.
options.explanation: Instance profile EC2 bukan mekanisme identitas bagi runner eksternal tersebut.

options.text: Trust the OIDC provider in an IAM role and restrict the token audience and subject to the approved jobs.
options.explanation: Federasi menghasilkan kredensial sementara; kondisi klaim membatasi pekerjaan yang boleh memakai role.

question: Engineers need read-only production access and deployment access in development through IAM Identity Center. Their corporate directory already maintains the groups. Which configuration avoids giving all engineers the same privileges everywhere?

options.text: Assign one administrator permission set to every group and rely on naming conventions.
options.explanation: Nama grup tidak membatasi izin yang sudah diberikan.

options.text: Use one read-only permission set for both accounts and let development users edit that permission set for their deployments.
options.explanation: Ini tidak menyediakan pembagian hak yang terkontrol; perubahan permission set dapat memengaruhi assignment lain.

options.text: Create a Cognito identity pool and treat its application roles as account permission sets.
options.explanation: Identitas aplikasi bukan pengganti assignment workforce di Identity Center.

options.text: Assign the directory groups to different permission sets in the appropriate accounts.
options.explanation: Assignment akun dan permission set memisahkan kewenangan meskipun identitas tetap sama.

question: A growing organization needs repeatable account provisioning, centralized log and audit accounts, and a consistent baseline of preventive and detective controls. Which service should orchestrate this landing-zone setup?

options.text: AWS Control Tower with an AWS Organizations-based landing zone.
options.explanation: Control Tower mengorkestrasi akun dan kontrol dasar; bukan sekadar menyimpan daftar akun.

options.text: AWS Cost Explorer with a consolidated billing dashboard.
options.explanation: Analisis tagihan tidak menerapkan baseline keamanan akun.

options.text: IAM Access Analyzer with the management account as its trust zone.
options.explanation: Analyzer menilai akses; tidak melakukan provisioning akun terkelola.

options.text: AWS Resource Access Manager with a resource share for all employees.
options.explanation: RAM berbagi resource yang didukung, bukan membangun landing zone.

question: A networking account owns VPCs and subnets. Application teams in other accounts in the same AWS organization must deploy their own supported resources into approved subnets while retaining ownership of those resources. Which approach fits?

options.text: Move all application resources into the networking account and give teams roles in that account.
options.explanation: Ini tidak mempertahankan kepemilikan resource oleh akun aplikasi seperti yang diminta.

options.text: Create an IAM group in the networking account containing roles from all member accounts.
options.explanation: Grup IAM bukan wadah role lintas akun dan tidak membagikan subnet.

options.text: Share the subnets through AWS RAM using VPC sharing.
options.explanation: Subnet dapat dibagikan sementara resource aplikasi tetap dimiliki akun peserta.

options.text: Use a Transit Gateway attachment to make another account the owner of a subnet.
options.explanation: Attachment menyediakan konektivitas, bukan mekanisme berbagi kepemilikan subnet.

question: A company keeps its Microsoft AD authoritative on premises. A supported AWS application needs to authenticate against that directory over existing private connectivity. The company wants a directory gateway, not new domain controllers or a synchronized cloud directory. Which option fits?

options.text: AD Connector.
options.explanation: AD Connector meneruskan permintaan ke AD asal tanpa membuat direktori replika di cloud.

options.text: An IAM group with the same name as the on-premises domain.
options.explanation: Grup IAM tidak memproses autentikasi direktori AD.

options.text: A new AWS Managed Microsoft AD forest with separately provisioned users.
options.explanation: Membuat domain baru tidak sesuai kebutuhan gateway tanpa direktori baru.

options.text: A Cognito user pool with a copied password database.
options.explanation: Menyalin identitas tidak memenuhi penggunaan direktori otoritatif yang sama.

question: A company is deploying directory-aware Windows applications in AWS. It needs a new managed AD domain, group policies, and a trust relationship with its existing on-premises AD. Which service meets these requirements with the least domain-controller administration?

options.text: AWS Managed Microsoft AD.
options.explanation: Menyediakan AD terkelola dan mendukung trust untuk memakai identitas domain yang sudah ada.

options.text: An IAM Identity Center permission set for Windows group-policy processing.
options.explanation: Permission set mengatur akses AWS, bukan kebijakan domain Windows.

options.text: AD Connector as the new domain controller hosting group policies.
options.explanation: Connector adalah gateway; bukan domain controller untuk domain baru.

options.text: An Amazon Cognito user pool for LDAP and domain-join operations.
options.explanation: User pool tidak menyediakan fungsi AD domain controller.

question: A deployment role can create Lambda functions but must let them access only a designated application bucket. The role currently has iam:PassRole on every role in the account. Which change best closes the privilege-escalation path?

options.text: Allow the deployer to pass only roles tagged Approved, while also letting it freely change that tag on every role.
options.explanation: Kontrol tag dapat dibypass oleh deployer yang bebas memberi tag Approved pada admin role.

options.text: Restrict only the deployment role's own s3:GetObject permissions.
options.explanation: Fungsi dapat memperoleh izin lebih luas lewat execution role yang diteruskan.

options.text: Restrict Lambda names to the project prefix while allowing every execution-role ARN.
options.explanation: Pembatasan nama fungsi tidak membatasi role berprivilege yang dapat dipasangkan.

options.text: Restrict iam:PassRole to approved least-privilege Lambda execution roles.
options.explanation: Caller dapat menjalankan kode memakai role yang dipasangkan; pembatasan role mencegah eskalasi.

question: Multiple partner accounts upload reports into a central S3 bucket. The bucket owner must own all objects and manage access through policies, without maintaining object ACLs. Which bucket configuration should be used?

options.text: S3 Versioning alone.
options.explanation: Versioning menyimpan versi tetapi tidak menetapkan model kepemilikan.

options.text: S3 Object Ownership set to Bucket owner enforced.
options.explanation: Pemilik bucket menjadi pemilik objek dan ACL dinonaktifkan; akses memakai policy.

options.text: Object writer ownership with a public-read ACL on every upload.
options.explanation: Uploader tetap memiliki objek dan publikasi melanggar kontrol akses.

options.text: Bucket owner preferred without requiring any compatible upload ACL.
options.explanation: Mode ini tidak selalu mengalihkan kepemilikan tanpa ACL upload yang tepat.

question: A role has permission to read two S3 buckets. Traffic uses an S3 gateway endpoint whose policy permits only Bucket A. The role attempts to read Bucket B through that endpoint. No resource policy grants an exception. What is the correct interpretation?

options.text: The request bypasses the endpoint policy automatically and uses the internet.
options.explanation: Routing tidak otomatis berganti untuk menghindari penolakan policy.

options.text: The endpoint policy can block the request; it does not grant additional S3 permissions.
options.explanation: Endpoint policy membatasi jalur tersebut dan tidak menggantikan izin identitas atau bucket.

options.text: The endpoint policy matters only to anonymous requests.
options.explanation: Policy endpoint juga mengevaluasi akses principal terautentikasi.

options.text: The endpoint policy adds Bucket B because the IAM role already allows it.
options.explanation: Izin role tidak memperluas daftar resource yang diizinkan endpoint.

question: An internal REST API in API Gateway must be invoked only through one approved VPC endpoint. It must not expose a public API endpoint. Which combination provides the required perimeter?

options.text: Use a Regional public API and remove its DNS record from the company website.
options.explanation: Menyembunyikan link bukan pembatasan jaringan.

options.text: Use a private REST API with an interface endpoint and a resource policy restricting aws:SourceVpce.
options.explanation: Endpoint privat menentukan jalur; resource policy membatasi endpoint yang boleh memanggil API.

options.text: Place a NAT gateway in front of the API Gateway service.
options.explanation: NAT untuk egress VPC tidak mengubah endpoint API menjadi privat.

options.text: Use an edge-optimized API and require an API key.
options.explanation: API key tidak menjadikan endpoint publik sebagai privat.

question: A paid REST API uses API Gateway usage plans and API keys to meter customers. It also needs to validate signed user tokens and authorize each request. What should the architect add?

options.text: A private DNS name without any authorization checks.
options.explanation: DNS bukan mekanisme validasi token atau izin.

options.text: Longer API keys so they become user authentication tokens.
options.explanation: Panjang key tidak mengubah fungsi usage key menjadi validasi identitas pengguna.

options.text: A suitable authorizer that validates tokens, while retaining API keys for usage-plan tracking.
options.explanation: Autentikasi dan otorisasi dipisahkan dari metering API key.

options.text: A larger usage-plan quota to prevent unauthorized requests.
options.explanation: Kuota mengatur volume secara best effort, bukan hak akses pengguna.

question: An internet-facing ALB accepts HTTPS for a web application. Security must block common SQL-injection patterns in HTTP requests without changing application code. Which control addresses this requirement most directly?

options.text: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the ALB and use appropriate SQL-injection rules.
options.explanation: WAF menilai isi permintaan HTTP; aturan harus diuji agar tidak memblokir trafik sah.

options.text: Add an ALB security-group rule that inspects SQL keywords.
options.explanation: Security group memfilter koneksi, bukan isi SQL pada HTTP.

options.text: Use a network ACL to allow port 443 only.
options.explanation: Pembatasan port tetap membiarkan payload berbahaya melalui HTTPS.

options.text: Enable Shield Standard and assume it removes every malicious HTTP payload.
options.explanation: Perlindungan DDoS bukan pengganti aturan inspeksi payload aplikasi.

question: Private workloads need outbound access, but security requires centrally managed Suricata-compatible inspection of traffic crossing the VPC perimeter. Which design meets the inspection requirement?

options.text: Add only a Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall rule and assume it performs stateful inspection of all outbound packets.
options.explanation: DNS filtering tidak menggantikan inspeksi stateful seluruh traffic pada jalur egress.

options.text: Enable GuardDuty and assume its findings block packets inline.
options.explanation: Deteksi ancaman tidak otomatis menjadi filter paket inline.

options.text: Route the relevant traffic through AWS Network Firewall endpoints with suitable stateful rules.
options.explanation: Firewall memerlukan jalur routing yang benar agar trafik benar-benar melewati inspeksi.

options.text: Attach AWS WAF directly to each private-subnet route table.
options.explanation: WAF bukan appliance routing yang dipasang pada route table.

question: A security team needs the same approved WAF rules applied to in-scope ALBs across existing and newly enrolled AWS accounts. Which service minimizes per-account policy maintenance?

options.text: AWS Firewall Manager with an organization-scoped policy.
options.explanation: Firewall Manager menerapkan kebijakan proteksi secara terpusat pada resource yang masuk cakupan.

options.text: AWS Shield Standard alone with no WAF policies.
options.explanation: Proteksi DDoS dasar tidak menyebarkan aturan WAF kustom.

options.text: Amazon Inspector scanning each account's EC2 packages.
options.explanation: Pemindaian kerentanan tidak mengelola web ACL.

options.text: AWS Resource Access Manager sharing the security account's ALB.
options.explanation: Berbagi resource bukan distribusi kebijakan proteksi ke semua ALB.

question: A team needs continuous assessment of supported EC2 instances and ECR container images for known software vulnerabilities. It already uses GuardDuty for suspicious activity. Which service fills the missing requirement?

options.text: Amazon Inspector.
options.explanation: Inspector menilai kerentanan software pada resource yang didukung, melengkapi deteksi aktivitas mencurigakan.

options.text: Amazon Macie.
options.explanation: Macie berfokus pada penemuan data sensitif di S3, bukan paket image.

options.text: AWS CloudTrail event history.
options.explanation: Riwayat API bukan scanner kerentanan paket.

options.text: Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall.
options.explanation: Filter DNS tidak membuat inventaris CVE untuk instance dan image.

question: A central security team wants a consolidated view of findings from GuardDuty, Inspector, and Macie and checks against AWS security best practices across accounts. Which service should provide that posture-management view?

options.text: AWS Security Hub CSPM.
options.explanation: Menggabungkan findings dan pemeriksaan standar keamanan; layanan sumber tetap menjalankan analisisnya.

options.text: AWS Artifact as a real-time account finding aggregator.
options.explanation: Artifact memberi dokumen kepatuhan AWS, bukan temuan resource pelanggan.

options.text: AWS Organizations consolidated billing.
options.explanation: Konsolidasi biaya bukan konsolidasi posture keamanan.

options.text: Amazon CloudWatch Logs as an automatic vulnerability and compliance engine.
options.explanation: Penyimpanan log saja tidak menggantikan evaluasi posture dan normalisasi findings.

question: A company requires every production security group to avoid unrestricted SSH ingress. It wants to detect drift and run an approved remediation workflow when a group becomes noncompliant. Which combination fits?

options.text: AWS Config rules with an appropriate remediation action.
options.explanation: Config menilai konfigurasi; workflow remediasi melakukan perubahan yang disetujui.

options.text: Route 53 health checks on the SSH port only.
options.explanation: Kesehatan endpoint bukan evaluasi kebijakan konfigurasi resource.

options.text: CloudTrail log retention with no rule evaluation or response.
options.explanation: Log merekam perubahan tetapi tidak sendiri mengevaluasi dan memperbaiki ketidakpatuhan.

options.text: S3 Object Lock on the application bucket.
options.explanation: Retensi objek tidak menilai aturan security group.

question: A company needs management-event audit logs from all accounts, including newly created accounts, delivered to a protected central S3 bucket. Member teams must not manage the central trail. Which design fits?

options.text: Use AWS Config alone to record every API request body.
options.explanation: Config mencatat konfigurasi dan evaluasi, bukan pengganti event audit API.

options.text: Use VPC Flow Logs instead of CloudTrail for all IAM API operations.
options.explanation: Flow Logs merekam metadata trafik jaringan, bukan seluruh aksi IAM.

options.text: Use a multi-Region organization trail with centrally controlled log storage and permissions.
options.explanation: Organization trail mencakup akun organisasi; penyimpanan dan akses log dikelola terpisah dari tim aplikasi.

options.text: Ask each team to download its console event history monthly.
options.explanation: Proses manual mudah terlewat dan tidak memberi baseline organisasi otomatis.

question: Administrators need audited shell sessions to private EC2 instances that have no internet egress. The instances have SSM Agent and the necessary IAM role. What networking should be added to use Session Manager without opening SSH?

options.text: Attach an internet gateway while leaving all routes unchanged.
options.explanation: Gateway tanpa jalur yang relevan tidak menyediakan koneksi layanan untuk agent.

options.text: Create an S3 gateway endpoint and assume it replaces all Systems Manager endpoints.
options.explanation: Akses S3 saja tidak cukup untuk channel layanan Session Manager.

options.text: Add an inbound port 22 rule from every administrator's home IP.
options.explanation: Ini mempertahankan SSH dan tidak memenuhi pendekatan Session Manager yang diminta.

options.text: Provide the required Systems Manager interface endpoints and permit the necessary HTTPS traffic.
options.explanation: Agent memerlukan jalur ke layanan Systems Manager; tidak perlu inbound SSH untuk sesi ini.

question: An SQS queue accepts messages from an SNS topic. Its policy currently allows the SNS service principal without restricting the source. The queue must accept only one approved topic. Which condition should narrow the service permission?

options.text: Change the queue visibility timeout to identify the sender.
options.explanation: Visibility timeout mengatur pemrosesan, bukan asal yang diotorisasi.

options.text: Restrict aws:SourceArn to the approved topic ARN, with suitable source-account checks where applicable.
options.explanation: Kondisi sumber mengikat izin service principal ke resource yang memang disetujui.

options.text: Use a vendor-generated ExternalId as the SNS message body.
options.explanation: ExternalId untuk delegasi role pihak ketiga bukan filter policy sumber SNS ini.

options.text: Allow every SNS topic because AWS service principals are always trusted.
options.explanation: Service principal yang sama dapat bertindak untuk resource dari pihak lain.

question: Analysts query an S3 data lake using Athena SQL and a Lake Formation-governed catalog. They may see transaction amounts but not personal identifiers. Direct S3 access is restricted. Which approach avoids maintaining separate dataset copies?

options.text: Encrypt the bucket and give all analysts unrestricted decrypt permission.
options.explanation: Enkripsi at rest tidak membedakan kolom yang boleh ditampilkan.

options.text: Grant read access to every object and hide identifier columns only in a dashboard.
options.explanation: Pengguna masih dapat membaca data mentah melalui jalur yang diizinkan.

options.text: Create an S3 bucket policy referencing CSV column numbers.
options.explanation: Bucket policy tidak memfilter kolom internal setiap objek.

options.text: Grant Lake Formation column-level permissions for the allowed columns.
options.explanation: Engine terintegrasi menerapkan izin kolom; pembatasan jalur S3 langsung mencegah bypass.

question: Regional analysts use Athena SQL on a shared Lake Formation table. Each group must see only rows for its own region. Which two controls are needed for an effective design? Select TWO.

options.text: Restrict direct access to the underlying S3 data so users cannot bypass the governed query path.
options.explanation: Hak baca file mentah dapat melewati pembatasan hasil query.

options.text: Use an S3 storage-class transition to remove unauthorized rows.
options.explanation: Lifecycle tidak menghapus baris berdasarkan identitas analis.

options.text: Set one Athena output filename per group and omit data permissions.
options.explanation: Nama output bukan kontrol izin atas data sumber.

options.text: Define appropriate Lake Formation row filters and grant the groups SELECT through those filters.
options.explanation: Filter baris membatasi hasil pada engine yang mendukung integrasi.

options.text: Give every analyst lake administrator permissions.
options.explanation: Administrator luas bertentangan dengan kebutuhan pembatasan grup.

question: A company enables automatic rotation on a supported symmetric customer managed KMS key. Existing encrypted objects must remain readable. Which statement correctly describes the result?

options.text: Previous ciphertext becomes unreadable as soon as new material is generated.
options.explanation: Material terdahulu tetap dipakai untuk dekripsi yang sesuai.

options.text: Every existing S3 object is automatically rewritten under the latest material immediately.
options.explanation: Rotasi KMS bukan pekerjaan re-encryption massal objek.

options.text: The logical key remains the same, and KMS retains earlier key material to decrypt older ciphertext.
options.explanation: Rotasi material tidak mengubah identitas key atau otomatis menulis ulang semua ciphertext.

options.text: All applications must replace the key ARN after each rotation.
options.explanation: Key ARN tetap sama pada rotasi material key tersebut.

question: A bucket contains existing objects encrypted with SSE-S3. New policy requires all objects to use a designated customer managed KMS key. The team changes the bucket's default encryption. What additional work is required for the existing objects?

options.text: Change only the bucket policy display name.
options.explanation: Nama policy tidak memodifikasi ciphertext.

options.text: Re-encrypt the existing objects through an appropriate copy or batch workflow and verify the result.
options.explanation: Default baru berlaku untuk penulisan baru; objek lama memerlukan tindakan migrasi enkripsi.

options.text: Wait for an automatic KMS rotation to convert all existing SSE-S3 objects.
options.explanation: Rotasi key tidak mengubah metode enkripsi objek yang sudah tersimpan.

options.text: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration to rewrite object metadata.
options.explanation: Akselerasi transfer bukan migrasi enkripsi at rest.

question: An application role in Account B needs to read an S3 object in Account A encrypted with Account A's customer managed KMS key. Which two permission layers must be appropriately configured? Select TWO.

options.text: S3 access through the role's permissions and the bucket's cross-account resource policy.
options.explanation: Akses data S3 harus diizinkan oleh model lintas akun yang relevan.

options.text: KMS decrypt authorization in the key policy and the external role's IAM policy.
options.explanation: Izin S3 tidak otomatis memberi izin memakai key akun lain.

options.text: Only the S3 ACL, because KMS decrypt permission is implied by GetObject.
options.explanation: Decrypt bukan izin implisit dari GetObject.

options.text: Only the KMS alias name, because aliases grant use to other accounts.
options.explanation: Alias mengidentifikasi key, bukan memberikan otorisasi.

options.text: Only a VPC peering connection between the accounts.
options.explanation: Jalur jaringan tidak menggantikan izin S3 atau KMS.

question: A legacy EC2 instance uses an unencrypted EBS data volume. The team can schedule a maintenance window and must preserve the data while encrypting it with a customer managed key. Which approach is appropriate?

options.text: Add TLS to the application and treat that as volume encryption.
options.explanation: TLS melindungi transit, bukan data pada volume.

options.text: Enable EBS encryption by default and assume the existing volume is converted without copying data.
options.explanation: Default encryption berlaku untuk pembuatan resource yang relevan, bukan otomatis mengubah volume lama.

options.text: Create a consistent snapshot, create an encrypted copy or encrypted restored volume, and replace the old volume after validation.
options.explanation: Migrasi mempertahankan data dan menghasilkan volume terenkripsi; konsistensi aplikasi tetap perlu direncanakan.

options.text: Enable EBS encryption by default and assume the attached volume becomes encrypted immediately.
options.explanation: Pengaturan default tidak mengubah volume lama secara in-place.

question: An existing EFS file system was created without encryption at rest. A new requirement mandates encryption for all files. Which plan meets the requirement?

options.text: Enable TLS for every NFS client connection and consider that sufficient encryption at rest.
options.explanation: TLS melindungi transport; requirement encryption at rest tetap memerlukan filesystem terenkripsi.

options.text: Create an encrypted EFS file system, migrate or replicate the data, and validate applications before cutover.
options.explanation: Pengaturan enkripsi EFS yang sudah dibuat tidak dapat ditukar secara in-place.

options.text: Enable only TLS on the current mount connections.
options.explanation: TLS melindungi transit tetapi tidak memenuhi enkripsi at rest.

options.text: Enable encryption at rest on the original file system without copying data.
options.explanation: EFS tidak menyediakan perubahan setting itu pada file system yang sudah ada.

question: A non-Aurora RDS database is unencrypted. A planned maintenance window permits migration to an encrypted replacement with the same engine. Which approach is appropriate?

options.text: Take a snapshot, copy it with encryption enabled, restore a new DB instance, and perform a validated cutover.
options.explanation: Salinan snapshot terenkripsi dapat menjadi sumber instance pengganti; endpoint aplikasi perlu diperbarui.

options.text: Add a read replica and assume it independently changes the source encryption state.
options.explanation: Replica tidak mengubah enkripsi source melalui asumsi tersebut.

options.text: Enable database-client TLS and declare stored snapshots encrypted.
options.explanation: TLS tidak mengubah enkripsi storage maupun snapshot lama.

options.text: Enable a checkbox to encrypt the existing DB instance in place immediately.
options.explanation: RDS tidak menyediakan konversi in-place tersebut untuk instance tidak terenkripsi.

question: A service signs an S3 download URL with temporary role credentials. The URL requests two hours of validity, but the role session expires in 30 minutes. What must the application account for?

options.text: The URL can be used exactly once because it is presigned.
options.explanation: Presigned URL biasanya dapat dipakai kembali selama masih valid.

options.text: The link can stop working when the signing credentials expire, even before its requested URL expiry.
options.explanation: URL bergantung pada kredensial penandatangan; expiry URL bukan satu-satunya batas.

options.text: The link becomes public permanently after the role expires.
options.explanation: Kedaluwarsa kredensial tidak mengubah objek menjadi publik.

options.text: The URL extends the role session automatically to two hours.
options.explanation: Presigning tidak memperpanjang sesi STS.

question: A central S3 bucket should be readable by approved roles only when requests come from the company's designated VPC endpoint. An organization-membership condition is already present. Which additional control addresses the missing requirement?

options.text: Assign a cost-allocation tag with the VPC endpoint ID.
options.explanation: Tag untuk biaya tidak otomatis menjadi kondisi otorisasi.

options.text: Enable versioning to force reads through private IP addresses.
options.explanation: Versioning mengatur versi objek, bukan rute akses.

options.text: Add an appropriate bucket-policy restriction using aws:SourceVpce while preserving required service access.
options.explanation: Keanggotaan organisasi tidak menentukan jalur jaringan; kondisi endpoint membatasi asal path.

options.text: Add more accounts to the organization and leave the network conditions unchanged.
options.explanation: Akun tambahan tidak menegakkan jalur endpoint.

question: An ALB uses an ACM-issued, DNS-validated public certificate. The team wants automatic renewal with minimal intervention. Which action is most appropriate?

options.text: Keep the validation DNS records in place and the certificate eligible for renewal through its supported association.
options.explanation: Validasi DNS berkelanjutan dan eligibility diperlukan untuk renewal terkelola.

options.text: Replace it with an imported certificate and assume ACM renews the external certificate automatically.
options.explanation: Sertifikat impor tidak memperoleh managed renewal ACM.

options.text: Delete validation records after issuance because they are never checked again.
options.explanation: Penghapusan record dapat mengganggu validasi renewal.

options.text: Change the ALB listener security policy and leave the certificate validation prerequisites removed.
options.explanation: Pilihan cipher/protocol listener tidak menggantikan prasyarat renewal sertifikat.

question: A legacy signing application requires a PKCS#11-compatible interface and customer administration of cryptographic users on dedicated single-tenant HSMs. The team accepts managing HSM users and cluster availability. Which service best matches?

options.text: AWS KMS direct API calls with no application changes.
options.explanation: API KMS bukan pengganti transparan interface PKCS#11 yang diwajibkan.

options.text: ACM certificate renewal alone.
options.explanation: Renewal sertifikat tidak menyediakan HSM umum untuk aplikasi signing.

options.text: AWS CloudHSM.
options.explanation: CloudHSM memberi kontrol HSM dan antarmuka kriptografi standar dengan tanggung jawab operasional tambahan.

options.text: AWS Secrets Manager as the cryptographic signing engine.
options.explanation: Penyimpanan secret bukan HSM untuk operasi tanda tangan tersebut.
